shortIntro.title: What Your Device Needs to Crush PUBG Mobile
shortIntro.para1: PUBG Mobile isn’t just another battle royale—it’s a fast-paced, chicken-dinner chasing arena where lag is your worst enemy. To keep your thumbs happy and your kills high, your device must meet certain specs.
shortIntro.para2: Entry-level phones can get by at 25–30 FPS with minimal settings, while mid-range and flagship devices can hit buttery smooth 60–90 FPS or even more with full graphics turned on.

intro: Here’s the official lowdown on the minimum and recommended specs to get PUBG Mobile running smoothly on Android devices—so you can drop, loot, and dominate without frame drops.

minimum.RAM: 2GB minimum (yes, you can try, but don’t blame us if it lags)
minimum.CPU: Snapdragon 435 / Exynos 7420 / MediaTek Helio P20 or equivalent

recommended.CPU: Snapdragon 675 / Exynos 8895 / Helio G90T or better
recommended.Internet: Low-latency 4G/5G or fast Wi-Fi for consistent aim and loot

faqIntroText: Got questions about PUBG Mobile performance, device support, or optimization? We got you:

faqList.question: Can PUBG Mobile run on 2GB RAM devices?
faqList.answer: Yes, but expect low FPS and choppy visuals. For a smooth experience, go for 4GB or more.

faqList.question: Does PUBG Mobile support high FPS modes?
faqList.answer: Absolutely! Mid-range devices handle 60 FPS easily, and high-end phones can even push 90 FPS (like butter!).

faqList.question: How fast does my internet need to be?
faqList.answer: 2–5 Mbps is the minimum, but 4G/5G or low-latency Wi-Fi ensures smooth loot grabs and no surprise deaths.
